verdict.rationale: gstack ships a /skillify skill that codifies a repeated /scrape intent into a reusable script, and domain skills let the agent save its own per-site skills and promote them from project to global. Both are narrow, auto-generated skill creation tied to browsing and site notes, not a general meta-skill that guides authoring arbitrary new skills. Dev mode only symlinks a checkout for contributors. missing for 10: a general-purpose guided skill-writing workflow, skill improvement/evaluation guidance, packaging/distribution tooling for new skills, independent corroboration.
